title: Embedding model sunset and rollout evacuation playbook (draft)
body:
Purpose:
This doc is a working playbook for sunsetting the v1-embed-legacy embeddings model and migrating production traffic to v2-embed-compact. The priority is minimal customer impact, predictable latency/price profile, and an auditable rollback path.

Scope:
- Affects hosted API routes: /v1/embeddings (default model mapping) for customers not pinning a model version.
- Affects Dedicated clusters with model pinning if their pinned model is v1-embed-legacy — coordinate with account teams.
- Time window: 6-week rollout starting 2026-09-01 (calendar below).

Goals:
- Retire v1-embed-legacy from autoserve pool by 2026-10-15.
- Ensure <0.1% client error delta at 95th percentile of cases during rollout.
- Maintain token cost variance < +/- 5% across traffic after routing to v2.

High-level timeline (calendar):
- 2026-08-12: Internal kickoff (this doc created).
- 2026-08-16 to 2026-08-30: Compatibility testing and perf bench (eng-serving-runtime + applied-ml).
- 2026-09-01: Begin soft canary (0.5% traffic -> v2).
- 2026-09-08: Expand to 5% if metrics green.
- 2026-09-15: Regional expansion (EU/NA full, APAC limited) to 20%.
- 2026-09-29: Opt-in migration window for pinned Dedicated customers (account outreach).
- 2026-10-06: Ramp to 60% and initiate sunset decommission schedule for autoserve nodes.
- 2026-10-13: Final 90-100% cutover and schedule drain of v1 nodes.
- 2026-10-15: v1 removed from autoserve pool; final deprecation announcement (public).

Preflight checklist (owners in <>):
- Confirm benchmark matrix: latency/throughput/cost at expected batch sizes on all target instance types (<Marcus Kim>).
- Validate functional parity tests (embedding dimensionality, normalizers, idempotence) across 500 sample prompts (<Applied ML team; Sofia Rios>).
- Update model catalog metadata and mark v1 as "sunsetting" with migration doc link (<Product-hosted-api>).
- Update routing policy rules for canary percentages in Smart Router config (<Platform-engineering; Daniel Nguyen>).
- Add telemetry hooks: sample prompts, quality signal counters, and delta histograms for cosine drift (<Observability; Priya Kapoor>).
- Draft customer-facing deprecation email and web banner copy (<Customer-success + comms>).
- Prepare rollback scripts: revert routing percentages and rehydrate v1 cache nodes (<Infrastructure; eng-serving-runtime>).
- Prepare a canary test harness runbook with synthetic scenarios and A/B comparison harness (<Developer-experience>).

Canary Runbook (day-of checklist):
- Start at 00:00 UTC on the day of soft canary. Ensure on-call for eng-sre and eng-serving-runtime are present for 4 hours after first traffic shift.
- Switch 0.5% hashed traffic (by customer tenant id) to v2 via Smart Router.
- Monitor these signals every 5 minutes for the first hour, then every 15 minutes for the next 5 hours:
  - Error rate (4xx/5xx) delta for canary cohort.
  - Latency P50/P95/P99 for token generation and total request.
  - Similarity/embedding quality: mean cosine similarity for known seed vectors; regression alert if delta > 0.07.
  - Cost per 1k embeddings estimate metric.
- If any signal exceeds threshold, execute immediate rollback (see rollback matrix).

Rollback matrix (quick reference):
- Trigger: error rate for canary > 0.5% absolute increase -> action: revert canary percentage to 0, escalate to on-call and product lead.
- Trigger: latency P95 increase > 40% or > 500ms absolute (whichever smaller) -> action: scale up v2 nodes for capacity test; if not improving in 15m, rollback.
- Trigger: quality regression (cosine drift > 0.10 on seed set) -> action: pause canary, snapshot failing queries, notify applied-ml and QA.
- Trigger: sustained cost delta > 10% -> action: hold ramp and discuss quantization/quant profile with Optimize team.

Communications and run-of-show:
- Internal Slack channel: #model-sunset-embed (create and invite eng leads, SRE, Product, CS). Use this for minute-by-minute updates.
- Create a Confluence post with real-time checklist and attach release notes draft (link in linked_artifacts).
- Customer comms cadence:
  - 2 weeks before public removal: targeted emails to Dedicated customers flagged as using v1 (Account execs to send).
  - 7 days before: blog + API banner (marketing + product).
  - On final removal: public deprecation note with help center migration steps.

Dedicated customer migration notes:
- For customers with pinned model version v1-embed-legacy, coordinate migration windows with Solutions Engineering. Offer a 2-week test window on Dedicated staging clusters with traffic mirroring.
- Run an early-access program for 3–5 strategic customers to validate semantics (dates: 2026-09-10 to 2026-09-24).

Observability and metrics (dashboard blueprint):
- Canary cohort filter by tenant id; panels: error rate, latency, token-cost-estimate, cosine-drift, tail latency distribution.
- Spike annotation: annotate live dashboard whenever we change canary percentage.
- Synthetic regression harness: run pre-check at T-0 and after ramp change; log outputs to central artifact store.

Post-deploy checklist (first 72 hours):
- 0–6 hours: confirm no customer-facing errors and no anomalies in telemetry.
- 6–24 hours: evaluate quality signals on fresh production traffic vs seed set; create a short quality report (<Applied ML>).
- 24–72 hours: escalate any slow drift findings; schedule hotfix release if required.
- 72 hours: remove canary cohort tagging and move to normal routing metrics.

Release notes (draft - customer facing):
- Title: Embeddings model update: v1-embed-legacy sunset and migration to v2-embed-compact.
- Summary: We are retiring an older embeddings model (v1-embed-legacy) and shifting default traffic to an improved model (v2-embed-compact) that offers similar embedding dimensions with lower memory usage and improved throughput. If you pin a model explicitly you will not be affected unless you choose to migrate.
- Migration steps (short):
  1) If you pin the model: update your model parameter to v2-embed-compact and run your test suite.
  2) If you don’t pin: no action required; your requests will be routed to the new model after the sunset date.
- FAQ snippets:
  Q: Will embeddings change? A: We expect minor numerical differences but preserved semantic similarity. We provide a seed set for comparing outputs.
  Q: Can I keep using v1? A: After 2026-10-15 v1 will not be served in the autoscale pool. For dedicated/private deployments, contact support for extended support.
  Q: What if I see regressions? A: Contact support with the "embedding-drift" tag and include examples; we will triage and rollback if widespread.

Open questions / notes to self (working):
- Need to confirm billing SKU mapping for v2 vs v1 prior to ramp (Finance check).
- Decide whether to include an automated compatibility checker in the SDK release.
- Confirm APAC node types for v2 perf parity; if unavailable, create soft hold for APAC expansion.
- Coordination: require product legal sign-off on deprecation wording.

Appendix: quick commands and links (ops):
- Roll routing to X%: curl -X POST $ROUTER/api/set-canary -d '{"model":"v2-embed-compact","percent":0.5}' (ops only).
- Rehydrate v1 nodes: playbook: infra/playbooks/rehydrate-v1-cache.md (internal repo).
- Synthetic seed set link: s3://redwood-internal/embeddings/seedsets/small-compare-v1-v2-2026-08-01.jsonl

Tone and doc state: draft. This doc is intentionally terse and operational — will convert to a nicer Confluence article after first successful canary. Keep edits in this Drive doc; do not finalize until telemetry window closes.

Choppy notes (scratch):
- If friction from Dedicated customers is high, propose a staggered deprecation with 6-month extended support for paid customers.
- Consider a migration CLI that runs samples and reports cosine deltas automatically.

-- end of draft --
